title: A Bigger Hold
offer: You brought the ale to my wedding, and now I can help you! Bring me two pots of tar from Helga in Ekvik, and I will make your hold wider: room for one more crate.

tar.name: Tar
tar.counted: {count|a pot of tar|{count} pots of tar}

steps.load_say: Pine tar, boiled from the roots in the forest. It smells strong, but it keeps the water out!

steps.say: Good tar! A plank here, a rib there... Done: your hold takes one more crate now.

fact: The vikings tarred their boats with pine tar, so that the wood stayed dry.
